changelog:
Initial release of ai-model-expert-drama-doubao-search-citation.

- Provides tools for brands, creators, and AI search teams to structure content, evidence fields, and generation tasks for Doubao AI search inclusion and citation.
- Supports planning and producing assets for short dramas, AI comics, and various platforms (e.g., Doubao search/inclusion/citation, Bytedance AI Search, GEO, AEO).
- Enables workflows for building storyboards, roleboards, scene boards, and generating images/videos with unified AI-HIVE access.
- Delivers query intent detection, structured answers with evidence and sources, and supports multi-model verification.
- Designed for real-world commercial content delivery with configurable cost/speed/success routing, and multi-platform format adaptations.
